unyielding.definition: s. resistant to physical force or pressure
unyielding.translation: a. 不易弯曲的, 不屈的

unyieldingness.definition: n. resoluteness by virtue of being unyielding and inflexible

unyoke.translation: vt. 卸除轭, 解除束缚

unyoked.definition:
a. Not yet yoked; not having worn the yoke.
a. Freed or loosed from a yoke.
a. Licentious; unrestrained.
unyoked.translation: v. 卸除轭( unyoke的过去式和过去分词 ); 解除束缚; 解开; 停止工作

unyokes.translation: v. 卸除轭( unyoke的第三人称单数 ); 解除束缚; 解开; 停止工作

unyoking.translation: v. 卸除轭( unyoke的现在分词 ); 解除束缚; 解开; 停止工作
